svg.title: Forty-seven CoreSmith CLI commands, by purpose and by reach
svg.desc: Every top-level command from coresmith --help, numbered in help order, in a grid. Columns: reads (the record or a schema, only queries); writes (validates, then records; a refusal may still record state, such as a stage's blockers); runs here (tools or generators in the CLI's process); engine (asks coresmithd, which runs the graphs). Define the chip — reads: 25 schema; writes: 13 register, 42 prd, 43 frd, 44 contract, 45 fabric, 46 pin, 41 target; runs here: 26 vip, 27 shell. Model and implement — reads: 40 pdk; runs here: 21 model, 22 harness, 10 verify, 39 tool; engine: 06 build, 04 architecture, 03 run, 05 backend. Inspect evidence — reads: 20 status, 23 block-status, 29 blocks, 32 block, 30 results, 33 attempts, 35 dv-status, 36 ppa, 37 coverage, 38 contracts, 31 settings; writes: 19 stage. Trace requirements — reads: 14 item, 34 constraints; writes: 15 link, 16 unlink, 17 check, 18 question, 11 ruling. Operate and recover — reads: 28 leases, 12 interrupts, 09 logs, 47 actions; runs here: 24 block-done; engine: 01 daemon, 02 supervisor, 07 state, 08 resume. build targets, list, show, compare and lineage read the record; stage status and target show read; state write writes views and state check reads. model author and harness author make one explicit helper call. block-done is a diagnostic; build module completes a module.
svg.text: Every top-level command, numbered in coresmith --help order.
Rows group them by purpose; columns by how far they reach.

text.tspan: more subcommands exist; those shown are representative.
before a subcommand: its reach differs from its column’s.
Every verb, including a refused one, is logged in
